# Day Analysis

_SKOS concept in the [PKM Vocabulary](../)._

Overall analytical synthesis of a day across domains.

## Scope note

- Includes Plus-Minus-Next analysis: overall, health, learning, and work.
- Generated by Claude AI during Morning Review workflow as a final report for the previous day.
- Compares DayPlan intentions and actual DayLog activities.
